strongest_result: Fixed Exp(1) OD growth rates on an optimized binary-tree network give an explicit shrinking phase window. Outside it r is exactly one or zero and every optimizer has a connected full spare graph or an edgeless spare graph, respectively, with explicit failure probability tending to zero.
limitations: Specialized many-destination cross-root demand pattern on a tree.
Concentration-based HOT construction, not a universal percolation law or SOC model.
Affine random demand growth has quadratic, not linear, time variance.
No finite-size expectation formula or critical-window profile beyond the exact finite min-cut derivative expression.
No claim of novelty for standard random-transport ingredients or the combined construction.
